learned_rules.claim: Nadi-9 primarily follows Canonical SOV (Subject - Object - Verb) word order in declarative sentences. Adverbs and temporal expressions precede the direct object.
learned_rules.statement: Nadi-9 primarily follows Canonical SOV (Subject - Object - Verb) word order in declarative sentences. Adverbs and temporal expressions precede the direct object.

learned_rules.claim: Present continuous and imperfective aspect is marked by the verbal suffix -ina attached to the verb root.
learned_rules.statement: Present continuous and imperfective aspect is marked by the verbal suffix -ina attached to the verb root.

learned_rules.claim: Simple past tense is marked by suffix -va.
learned_rules.statement: Simple past tense is marked by suffix -va.

learned_rules.claim: Simple future tense is marked by suffix -is.
learned_rules.statement: Simple future tense is marked by suffix -is.

learned_rules.claim: Standard verbal negation is formed with prefix na- bound to the verb stem (e.g. na-mani, na-chhod). It never occurs as a detached post-verbal particle in formal speech.
learned_rules.statement: Standard verbal negation is formed with prefix na- bound to the verb stem (e.g. na-mani, na-chhod). It never occurs as a detached post-verbal particle in formal speech.

learned_rules.claim: Kinship address incorporates prefixes depending on seniority. Elder brother in intimate familial address uses prefix da- (da-bhai). Respected mother takes honorific modifier tari (tari ama). Senior patriarchal figures take prefix vad-.
learned_rules.statement: Kinship address incorporates prefixes depending on seniority. Elder brother in intimate familial address uses prefix da- (da-bhai). Respected mother takes honorific modifier tari (tari ama). Senior patriarchal figures take prefix vad-.

learned_rules.claim: Urban speakers frequently borrow standard trade terms, but traditional narrative dialogue rejects English or high-court Persianisms unless indicating bureaucratic satire.
learned_rules.statement: Urban speakers frequently borrow standard trade terms, but traditional narrative dialogue rejects English or high-court Persianisms unless indicating bureaucratic satire.

learned_rules.claim: Yes/no questions conclude with sentence-final particle ki. Content questions place question words (kit, kyo) immediately preceding the verb.
learned_rules.statement: Yes/no questions conclude with sentence-final particle ki. Content questions place question words (kit, kyo) immediately preceding the verb.
